summary: The final completed iron-bars chew by a wizard polymorphed into a rust monster leaves all RNG, cursors, and earlier screens matched, but C changes the hunger status to Satiated while JavaScript omits that status. hack.c:still_chewing calls eat.c:morehungry(-nut) for metallivorous iron-bar eating and monmove.c:dissolve_bars after chewing; js/hack.js still_chewing currently has note_unported placeholders at both call sites. The missing morehungry side effect explains the exact final status mismatch; both existing canonical helpers must be wired to port this source path fully.

source.branch: test_move(DO_MOVE) targets IRONBARS and the current monster is metallivorous; after the chew effort exceeds 100, still_chewing awards rnd(20), then the IRONBARS branch grants iron nutrition with morehungry(-nut) and removes the bars with dissolve_bars.

evidence: Saved v42 baseline 2634fa9f632f0bd97556887204d19f3fdb2645f2: 52/53 screens, 2849/2849 RNG calls, and 53/53 cursors; the only mismatch is final step 52, key "l", at screen row 23 column 39 where C prints 'S' and JS prints a blank.

The independently decoded final C/JS status rows are respectively `Dlvl:1 $:0 HP:26(26) Pw:6(6) AC:2 HD:5 Satiated` and `Dlvl:1 $:0 HP:26(26) Pw:6(6) AC:2 HD:5`; all 8 changed cells form the missing `Satiated` status text.

upstream/src/hack.c:647-822 implements the entire still_chewing function; lines 769-784 award metallivorous iron-bar nutrition with morehungry(-nut), select the completion text, and call dissolve_bars before final vision/redraw cleanup. Its production call sites are all in upstream/src/hack.c:test_move at lines 1029, 1040, 1090, and 1227.

js/hack.js:1978-2082 has the corresponding still_chewing port. Its IRONBARS branch at lines 2078-2081 calls note_unported('eat.c morehungry') and note_unported('trap.c dissolve_bars') instead of existing canonical JS implementations.

The required helpers are already implemented: upstream/src/eat.c:3281-3285 / js/eat.js:1902-1917 implement morehungry and newuhs; upstream/src/monmove.c:2170-2180 / js/monmove.js:4322-4334 implement dissolve_bars. Wire these existing owners from hack.js without duplicating their state logic.

A second direct C caller is upstream/src/eat.c:doeat (the `&hands_obj` arm at line 2852), which calls still_chewing on the hero’s current square and then prints “You pause to swallow.” while IRONBARS remain. js/eat.js:doeat at lines 4238-4244 already wires this caller to the canonical hack.js still_chewing implementation. No matching `recordings/` entry covers this `e`-command branch, so it needs its own matching recipe/recording as an entry point in addition to the admitted movement case.
